Package domain.controller

Class HidatoController

java.lang.Object
domain.controller.HidatoController
public class HidatoController extends Object
Controller class for managing Hidato puzzle solving and generation operations.

This class is responsible for:

  • Creating and managing the graph representation of a Hidato puzzle
  • Checking if a Hidato puzzle has a solution
  • Solving Hidato puzzles
  • Generating new Hidato puzzles and producing solvable puzzles according to difficulty

    • generateHidato

      public String generateHidato(String topology, Adjacency ad, int nC, Difficulty dif)
      Generates a Hidato puzzle according to the provided topology, adjacency, cell count and difficulty.
      Parameters:
      topology - topology code (e.g. "Q", "T", "H")
      ad - adjacency mode to use for generation
      nC - approximate number of cells desired in the generated puzzle
      dif - difficulty to apply when generating the puzzle
      Returns:
      a string representation of the generated Hidato (topology + content) suitable for later parsing or display

    • makeSolvable

      public String makeSolvable(String Solution, Difficulty dif, int nC)
      Produces a solvable puzzle version from a full solution string according to the requested difficulty and number of cells.
      Parameters:
      Solution - the full solution string (complete Hidato representation)
      dif - the difficulty level to apply when hiding cells
      nC - the number of cells
      Returns:
      a string representing the puzzle version with hidden cells, or null if conversion failed

    • makeSolvable

      public String makeSolvable(String Solution, String difficuly, int nC)
      Convenience overload that accepts the difficulty as a string ("EASY", "MEDIUM", "HARD"). Maps the string to the Difficulty enum and delegates to makeSolvable(String, Solution, Difficulty dif, int nC).
      Parameters:
      Solution - the full solution string
      difficuly - difficulty name (case-sensitive expected values: "EASY", "MEDIUM", "HARD")
      nC - number of cells to hide
      Returns:
      a string representing the puzzle with hidden cells, or null on failure

    • str2csv

      public void str2csv(String Hidato, String path)
      Writes the content of the Hidato string to a CSV file. If an I/O error occurs, the method prints an error message to System.err.
      Parameters:
      Hidato - the string content to be saved (expected CSV formatted or plain text representation)
      path - the file path (including filename.csv) where the file will be created or overwritten
